source: ESPN public cricket API (site.api.espn.com, league 1490537 = ESPNcricinfo series 1490537), imported by tools/import-espn-season.js
note: Real WBBL|11 (2025-26) results — 40 league matches plus Knockout, Challenger and Final — used ONLY to derive each team's 2026 starting prior (src/priors.js). Unlike data/cpl_2025.json the phase fields are REAL: ppRuns (overs 1-6) and deathRuns (overs 16-20) are summed from ESPN's over-by-over runs. The four no-results (matches 4, 26, 27 and 37) carry innings: [] and winner: null, the same convention as the CPL file, so the engine skips them.
nrrNote: DLS results carry explicit nrrRuns/nrrOvers on each innings: the side batting first is credited with (revised target - 1) from the chasing side's allotted overs, per the playing conditions. Rain-reduced all-out innings carry oversQuota.
verification: Engine season NRR over the 40 league matches reproduces the published final table (Wikipedia, sourced to ESPNcricinfo): Hurricanes +0.662, Sixers -0.313, Scorchers -0.132, Stars +0.629, Renegades +0.121, Strikers +0.077, Heat -0.869 exactly; Thunder -0.124 against a published -0.126. W/L/NR/Pts match for all eight sides. Hobart Hurricanes beat Perth Scorchers in the Final (13 Dec 2025).
